# FRAMEWORK-IMPROVEMENTS — suggestions for cap-evolve itself (cross-run)

NOT about this capability or this run's result — about what cap-evolve the FRAMEWORK should change so FUTURE runs (any capability, any project) go better: a confusing prompt section, a missing tool, a file you wished existed, a gate that felt wrong. Optional most iterations; add an entry whenever something about the framework itself (not the task) got in your way or surprised you.

<!-- cap-evolve:framework-improvements-append-below -->

- A stray `/tmp/struct.py` on the host shadows the stdlib `struct` module whenever python runs with cwd=/tmp (numpy import fails). The optimizer's scratch area should not be a directory that already has importable .py files, or it should say so in INSTRUCTIONS.md.
- Surfacing the adapter's secondary metrics (recalc vs no_recalc) per failing task in the trajectory summary would make the "formula written instead of value" cluster obvious without opening each JSON. The data is already in score.raw.
- An "empty seed" where prompt.md exists but is 0 bytes (no system message) behaves differently from a missing prompt.md (default role line). Stating which one is in effect in INSTRUCTIONS.md would save a read of the adapter.
